gemini.rationale: The customer-facing asset base (T4) transferred whole, but the self-managed operating organization (T6) was terminated, with all employees fired at closing. The operational processes (T5) were bridged only partially via discretionary offers from GOV's external manager, creating a structural mismatch between the transferred assets and the terminated organization/processes.

grok.rationale: The structural summary and closing 8-K/DEFM14A state the customer-facing DC-region portfolio (T4) moved whole into the GOV acquisition vehicle while the Company's self-managed operating organization was terminated rather than retained, with operating processes only optionally bridged via discretionary RMR LLC employment offers to some former employees (gap_45=1). All board members, named executive officers, and other employees were terminated at consummation, so any continuing processes lacked coherent transfer of the T6 organization that had run them (gap_56=1). No transitional-services or operating agreement absorbing the shared substrate is documented—only severance, COBRA, and discretionary offer provisions.

openai.rationale: The structural summary states that the customer-facing office and business-park portfolio moved whole into GOV's acquisition vehicle, while the Company's self-managed operating organization was terminated and operations were instead bridged through discretionary RMR LLC employment offers to only some former employees. This documents a product-versus-process mismatch at closing and a re-engineering of operations without the existing organization transferring intact. The slice identifies no transitional-services or operating agreement contractually allocating the shared operational substrate.
